grid.expression: SELECT MPS.NUMPS,CM.DESCRICAO, MPS.DTINICMPS, DTFINMPS, MPS.CODCMPS FROM TPRMPS MPS INNER JOIN TPRCMPS CM ON (MPS.CODCMPS = CM.CODCMPS) WHERE MPS.CODCMPS = 1 /*LISTA DE MPS DE COMPRA MENSAL */

grid.title: :A_VALUE
grid.expression: /* OBTEM_TOTAIS_MRP(NRO MPS, CODPRODPA, CODPRODMP,TIPO) P_TIPO: M-META PA ; P - PRODUCAO PA; S - SALDO PRODUZIR PA N - NECESSIDADE MP NO MRP FILTRADO NA - NECESSIDADE C - NECESSIDADE COMPRA MP NO MRP FILTRADO E - ESTOQUE DISPONÍVEL MP O - Ordem/Pedido de Compra */ SELECT LMP.CODPRODMP, SUM(LMP.QTDMISTURA*NVL(I.QTDPRODUZIRLIQ,0)) AS QTDMPS, OBTEM_TOTAIS_MRP(I.NUMPS,NVL(:P_CODPRODPA,0),LMP.CODPRODMP,'O') AS TOTPEDCPA, OBTEM_TOTAIS_MRP(I.NUMPS,NVL(:P_CODPRODPA,0),LMP.CODPRODMP,'NA') AS SALDOMPSANT, OBTEM_TOTAIS_MRP(I.NUMPS,0,LMP.CODPRODMP,'E') AS ESTOQUEMP, PRO.DESCRPROD AS DESCRMP, PRO.CODVOL, NVL(PRO.AGRUPCOMPMINIMO,PRO.AGRUPMIN) AS AGRUPMIN, PRO.CODPARCFORN ,PAR.NOMEPARC FROM TPRIMPS I, TPRPRC PRC, TPRLPA LPA, TPRLMP LMP, TPRATV ATV , TPROEST EST, TGFPRO PRO LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON (PAR.CODPARC = PRO.CODPARCFORN) WHERE PRC.IDPROC = I.IDPROC AND I.CODPROD = LPA.CODPRODPA AND LPA.CODPRODPA = LMP.CODPRODPA AND LMP.CODPRODMP = PRO.CODPROD AND I.IDPROC = ATV.IDPROC AND EST.IDEFX = ATV.IDEFX AND LMP.IDEFX = ATV.IDEFX AND LPA.IDPROC = I.IDPROC AND EST.TIPOITENS='PA' --- APENAS ATIVIDADE APONTAMENTO AND I.NUMPS = :A_NUMPS AND (PRO.CODPARCFORN = :P_CODPARC OR :P_CODPARC IS NULL) AND (LMP.CODPRODPA = :P_CODPRODPA OR :P_CODPRODPA IS NULL) GROUP BY LMP.CODPRODMP, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.CODVOL, NVL(PRO.AGRUPCOMPMINIMO,PRO.AGRUPMIN), PRO.CODPARCFORN,PAR.NOMEPARC, I.NUMPS HAVING SUM(LMP.QTDMISTURA*I.QTDPRODUZIRLIQ) > 0 ORDER BY PAR.NOMEPARC, 2 DESC,3

grid.title: PAs / PIS dependentes da Matéria Prima selecionada
grid.expression: /* Formatted on 28/02/2022 19:34:56 (QP5 v5.115.810.9015) */ SELECT DADOS.*, OBTEM_TOTAIS_MRP(NUMPS,CODPROD,0,'S') AS SALDOPA_PROD_ANT, ( SELECT MP.QTDMISTURA FROM TPRPRC PRC INNER JOIN TPRLPA LPA ON (PRC.IDPROC = LPA.IDPROC) INNER JOIN TPREFX EF ON (EF.IDPROC = LPA.IDPROC) INNER JOIN TPRLMP MP ON (MP.IDEFX = EF.IDEFX AND MP.CODPRODPA = LPA.CODPRODPA) WHERE PRC.CODPRC = DADOS.CODPRC AND PRC.VERSAO = DADOS.VERSAO AND MP.CODPRODPA = DADOS.CODPROD AND MP.CODPRODMP = :A_CODPRODMP) AS QTDFORMULA FROM ( SELECT TPRIMPS.CODPROD, TPRIMPS.NUMPS, TPRIMPS.QTDPRODUZIRLIQ AS QTDPRODUZIRLIQ, (SELECT NVL (QTDPREV, 0) FROM (SELECT NVL (QTDPREV, 0) AS QTDPREV FROM TGFMET MET, TPRMPS MPS WHERE MET.CODMETA = 3 AND MET.CODPROD = TPRIMPS.CODPROD AND MPS.NUMPS = TPRIMPS.NUMPS AND MET.DTREF = TRUNC (MPS.DTFINMPS, 'MM')) D) AS AD_QTDPREV, (SELECT NVL (QTDPRODUZIR, 0) FROM (SELECT SUM (PA.QTDPRODUZIR) AS QTDPRODUZIR FROM TPRIPROC PROC INNER JOIN TPRIPA PA ON (PROC.IDIPROC = PA.IDIPROC) INNER JOIN TPRMPS MPS ON (PROC.NUMPS = MPS.NUMPS) WHERE STATUSPROC IN ('A', 'F', 'R', 'P2') AND PA.CODPRODPA = TPRIMPS.CODPROD AND PROC.NUMPS IN (SELECT MP.NUMPS FROM TPRMPS MP WHERE MP.CODCMPS = MPS.CODCMPS AND TRUNC (MP.DTINICMPS, 'MM') = TRUNC (MPS.DTINICMPS, 'MM'))) D) AS AD_QTDREAL, (SELECT SUM (QTDPREV - QTDPRODUZIR) FROM (SELECT 0 AS QTDPREV, SUM (QTDPRODUZIR) AS QTDPRODUZIR FROM TPRIPROC PROC INNER JOIN TPRIPA PA ON (PROC.IDIPROC = PA.IDIPROC) INNER JOIN TPRMPS MPS ON (PROC.NUMPS = MPS.NUMPS) WHERE STATUSPROC IN ('A', 'F', 'R', 'P2') AND PA.CODPRODPA = TPRIMPS.CODPROD AND TRUNC (PROC.DHINST, 'MM') = TRUNC (MPS.DTFINMPS, 'MM') UNION ALL SELECT NVL (QTDPREV, 0) AS QTDPREV, 0 AS QTDPRODUZIR FROM TGFMET MET, TPRMPS MPS WHERE MET.CODMETA = 3 AND MET.CODPROD = TPRIMPS.CODPROD AND MPS.NUMPS = TPRIMPS.NUMPS AND MET.DTREF = TRUNC (MPS.DTINICMPS, 'MM')) D) AS AD_QTDSALDO, (SELECT P.CODPRC FROM TPRPRC P WHERE P.IDPROC = TPRIMPS.IDPROC) AS CODPRC, (SELECT NVL (SUM (IPA.QTDPRODUZIR), 0) AS TOTAL FROM TPRIPA IPA INNER JOIN TPRIPROC IPROC ON (IPA.IDIPROC = IPROC.IDIPROC) INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON (IPA.CODPRODPA = PRO.CODPROD) WHERE IPROC.NUMPS = TPRIMPS.NUMPS AND IPA.CODPRODPA = TPRIMPS.CODPROD AND (PRO.TIPCONTEST IN ('L', 'N') OR (IPA.CONTROLEPA = TPRIMPS.CONTROLE)) AND IPROC.STATUSPROC NOT IN ('C', 'F') AND TPRIMPS.SEQIMPSPAI IS NULL AND (TPRIMPS.DTPREVENT IS NULL OR IPROC.DTPREVENT IS NULL OR TRUNC (IPROC.DTPREVENT) = TRUNC (TPRIMPS.DTPREVENT))) AS QTDEMOP, (SELECT NVL (SUM (IPA.QTDPRODUZIR), 0) AS QTDPRODUZIR FROM TPRIPA IPA INNER JOIN TPRIPROC IPROC ON (IPA.IDIPROC = IPROC.IDIPROC) INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON (IPA.CODPRODPA = PRO.CODPROD) WHERE IPROC.STATUSPROC IN ('AP', 'P') AND IPROC.NUMPS = TPRIMPS.NUMPS AND IPA.CODPRODPA = TPRIMPS.CODPROD AND (PRO.TIPCONTEST IN ('L', 'N') OR (IPA.CONTROLEPA = TPRIMPS.CONTROLE)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TPRPIPROC PIPROC WHERE PIPROC.IDIPROC = IPROC.IDIPROC) AND (TPRIMPS.DTPREVENT IS NULL OR IPROC.DTPREVENT IS NULL OR TRUNC (IPROC.DTPREVENT) = TRUNC (TPRIMPS.DTPREVENT))) AS QTDEMPROGRAMACAO, (NVL ( (QTDPRODUZIRLIQ - (SELECT NVL (SUM (IPA.QTDPRODUZIR), 0) AS TOTAL FROM TPRIPA IPA INNER JOIN TPRIPROC IPROC ON (IPA.IDIPROC = IPROC.IDIPROC) INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON (IPA.CODPRODPA = PRO.CODPROD) WHERE IPROC.NUMPS = TPRIMPS.NUMPS AND IPA.CODPRODPA = TPRIMPS.CODPROD AND (PRO.TIPCONTEST IN ('L', 'N') OR (IPA.CONTROLEPA = TPRIMPS.CONTROLE)) AND IPROC.STATUSPROC NOT IN ('C', 'F') AND TPRIMPS.SEQIMPSPAI IS NULL AND (TPRIMPS.DTPREVENT IS NULL OR IPROC.DTPREVENT IS NULL OR TRUNC (IPROC.DTPREVENT) = TRUNC (TPRIMPS.DTPREVENT)))), 0 )) AS QTDSALDOPRODUZIR, (SELECT P.VERSAO FROM TPRPRC P WHERE P.IDPROC = TPRIMPS.IDPROC) AS VERSAO, ProcessoProdutivo.DESCRABREV AS l0_DESCRABREV, Produto.DECQTD AS l1_DECQTD, Produto.DESCRPROD AS l1_DESCRPROD FROM TPRIMPS LEFT JOIN ( SELECT IDPROC, DESCRABREV FROM TPRPRC) ProcessoProdutivo ON (TPRIMPS.IDPROC = ProcessoProdutivo.IDPROC) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DESCRPROD, DECQTD, CODPROD FROM TGFPRO) Produto ON (TPRIMPS.CODPROD = Produto.CODPROD) WHERE ( (TPRIMPS.NUMPS = :A_NUMPS AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TPRBOM BOM WHERE CODPRODMP = :A_CODPRODMP AND BOM.NUMPS = TPRIMPS.NUMPS AND BOM.SEQIMPS = TPRIMPS.SEQIMPS))) AND (TPRIMPS.CODPROD = :P_CODPRODPA OR :P_CODPRODPA IS NULL) ORDER BY DESCRABREV, l1_DESCRPROD) DADOS
